zh: 公司账户里有两万美元
en: The company has $20,000 in the bank.

zh: 终于可以给自己发奖金了

en: But the accountant says: hold on.
Can you take that money? Why not?
Here is a key business concept.

zh: 需要有足够的资金周转
en: need enough funds to keep moving.

zh: 不代表这些钱都能拿走
en: does not mean you can take it all.
But next month it must pay:

zh: 账户里明明有两万美元
扣掉即将到期的一万七千美元
如果老板拿走一万美元
公司就有可能付不起账单
en: the business may miss its bills.

zh: 所以老板不能只看账户余额
en: So look beyond the bank balance.

zh: 还要看未来什么时候收钱

en: And how much should the business keep

zh: 这就是为什么现金规划

en: matters so much to small businesses.

zh: 还要考虑税款贷款和其他支出
en: also face taxes, loans and other costs.
how much cash you have now.

zh: 这些钱能不能安全地花
en: whether you can safely spend it.
